images.title: Two triangles on one diagonal
images.purpose: Show a rhombus cut along one diagonal into two triangles, each with half the other diagonal as height.
images.composition: One rhombus with its long diagonal horizontal, the two halves in two colours, areas written inside.
images.exact_structure: Plain white background, the main figure large and centred with generous empty margins on all sides, thin dark outlines (#2B2B2B), flat fills, nothing else in the frame. A rhombus with a horizontal diagonal 10 units long and a vertical diagonal 6 units long, crossing at the centre at right angles. Top triangle (above the horizontal diagonal) filled #0072B2, bottom triangle filled #E69F00. The horizontal diagonal drawn as a thick solid line labelled '10 cm'. The vertical diagonal dashed #CC79A7, with a right angle mark at the centre; its upper half labelled '3 cm' and its lower half labelled '3 cm'. Inside the top triangle '15 cm²', inside the bottom triangle '15 cm²'. Below the figure 'Total 30 cm²'.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Two triangles of 1/2 × 10 × 3 each make 30 cm², half of 10 × 6.
images.description: Show a rhombus cut along one diagonal into two triangles, each with half the other diagonal as height.
images.context: Concept T7.C2; one image showing only the main idea.

image_decisions.why: The two triangle cut on one diagonal is the derivation; the picture is the argument.
